title: THe 2014 Porsche 911 Turbo | Road & Track
summary: Road & Track puts a 2014 Porsche 911 Turbo through 50 back-to-back launch-control runs on a SoCal runway. The car completes 61 launches before the testers lose count.
why: HN cites it as the reference for repeatable performance, especially when comparing Tesla's Ludicrous mode and other EV launches.

quote.text: Road & Track did exactly that in 2014 with a Porsche 911 Turbo[1] and they were able to do 61 back-to-back launches.
